title: Sent-archive restriction asymmetry: authenticated non-admin populates _sent indirectly
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py:326-332. SentMessagesResource.render_post restricts archive writes to loopback-admin but MessagesResource.render_post also writes _sent for any OSCORE-authenticated peer posting to /msg/inbox with client-chosen to (including all). Policy inconsistency requiring explicit decision either tighten or document.
close_reason: POLICY CHOSEN: sent-archive recording follows the /msg/inbox posting rules (any authenticated peer's outbound copies are recorded by MessagesResource.render_post); the admin-only restriction applies ONLY to directly POSTing /msg/sent, so mesh peers cannot fabricate archive history out of band. Basis: spec/11-lci.md 17.6.3 access levels + vectors msg_sent_mesh_forbidden/msg_sent_local_admin (both carry no OSCORE identity, so they pin loopback-admin allowed / unauthenticated-mesh denied without constraining OSCORE peers' indirect recording). Implementation: replaced misleading 'Writing to the sent archive is an admin operation' comment on SentMessagesResource.render_post with an explicit POLICY statement describing both halves; recording side untouched. Tests TestSentArchivePolicy: authenticated non-admin inbox POST records sent copy; same peer direct POST /msg/sent -> 4.01 with zero mutation; loopback admin direct POST -> CREATED with location-path ('msg','sent','1'). Known cross-impl divergence flagged for maintainers: firmware lichen_msg_sent_post gates oscore||admin rather than admin-only; vectors treated as authoritative per repo policy.
